description: Software engineering team for WhatsApp AI Bot development and maintenance

members.name: team-lead
members.role: Orchestrates tasks, monitors progress, integrates outputs

members.name: ai-integration
members.role: AI providers, load balancing, prompt engineering

members.name: nlp-ml-engineer
members.role: Intent classifier, NLP cache, Python inference server, training

members.name: frontend-developer
members.role: React 18 dashboard, Vite, TailwindCSS, real-time UI

members.name: security-specialist
members.role: Auth, encryption, input sanitization, secret handling, dependency CVEs

members.name: qa-testing
members.focus: Jest + Supertest, message flow, log emoji markers, regression hunting

members.name: code-reviewer
members.role: Pre-merge code review, second opinions, architectural feedback

members.name: performance-engineer
members.role: Profiling, hot-path optimization, memory leaks, bundle size
members.focus: Message handler hot path, Map caches, MongoDB queries, frontend bundle

hooks.PreToolUse: tsc --noEmit blocks `git commit` if type errors present
hooks.UserPromptSubmit: Reminder about pino + emoji log markers when prompt mentions console.log

steps: team-lead receives request and decomposes into tasks
team-lead assigns to specialists (backend, frontend, ai, db, nlp, security)
specialists implement assigned work in parallel where possible
code-reviewer reviews diff before merge
security-specialist reviews if auth/secrets/encryption touched
qa-testing validates implementation
performance-engineer audits if hot path was touched
team-lead integrates and closes tasks
qa-testing reproduces and diagnoses issue
team-lead creates fix task with root cause
specialist (by area) implements fix
code-reviewer reviews
qa-testing validates fix and adds regression test
team-lead closes bug task
devops prepares .env and verifies CI workflows
devops runs npm run build + health check
security-specialist confirms JWT_SECRET + ENCRYPTION_KEY are set for prod
team-lead validates deployment via /health endpoint
whatsapp-specialist tests WhatsApp connection + QR flow
security-specialist invokes /security-review skill
Cross-check with code-reviewer for cross-cutting concerns
Output severity-labeled findings
team-lead decides merge / block based on findings

communication.protocol: Use Agent (subagent_type=<name>) to delegate; use TaskCreate/TaskUpdate for tracking
